limitations: Arm inertials come from the SolidWorks export and are not hardware validated.
Arm effort is startup/stop peak torque, not continuous rated torque; scalar caps do not enforce thermal/duty-cycle limits.
Arm friction/damping are zero placeholders from V3, not identified hardware parameters.
Joint-space values of the previous model do not apply; consumers must migrate.
maintenance: Single maintained URDF; legacy generators and original source models are in archived_sources.
